title: Inn4Smart — Enterprise Data Integration Workflow
summary: A pipeline that turned large, messy spreadsheet datasets into structured JSON and moved thousands of records reliably through an external API — with the failure handling that makes 'reliable' actually mean something.
problem: Large spreadsheet-based datasets needed to become structured data that could move through an external API workflow at scale. The catch is that at thousands of records, things go wrong constantly — malformed rows, rejected payloads, timeouts — and a pipeline that only works on the happy path isn't a pipeline you can trust.
approach: Built and supported the flow end to end: spreadsheet input processing, transformation into structured JSON, submission to the external API, and then the parts that actually matter — response checks, validation, retry behavior on failure, and failure logging so problems were visible instead of silent. I pushed edge cases hard in Postman, worked alongside QA and product across an 8-release cadence, documented the failure and recovery procedures, and trained 6+ users to run and troubleshoot it.
outcome: Thousands of records moved through the external API workflow with failures made detectable, understandable, and recoverable — plus documented recovery procedures and 6+ trained users so the pipeline didn't depend on one person to keep running.
